Measured steady-state ~1300 ticks/harvest, ~1.9-2x over budget, extrapolating to ~3x slower than the leader. See experiments/hay_single/002/result.md; 003 prices a dedicated wood income to unlock Carrot before concluding the category can't close the gap.
